hosea.2.p1.b1.text: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’

hosea.2.p1.b2.text: Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife, and I am not her husband.

hosea.2.p1.b3.text: I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.

hosea.2.p1.b4.text: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up her path with thorns; I will enclose her with a wall, so she cannot find her way.

hosea.2.p1.b5.text: I will return to my first husband, for then I was better off than now.

hosea.2.p2.b1.text: For she does not acknowledge that it was I who gave her grain, new wine, and oil, who lavished on her silver and gold— which they crafted for Baal.

hosea.2.p2.b2.text: Therefore I will take back My grain in its time and My new wine in its season …

hosea.2.p2.b3.text: I will put an end to all her exultation: her feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths— all her appointed feasts.

hosea.2.p2.b4.text: … when she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers. But Me she forgot … declares the LORD.

hosea.2.p3.b1.text: “Therefore, behold, I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness, and speak to her tenderly.

hosea.2.p3.b2.text: … make the Valley of Achor into a gateway of hope.

hosea.2.p3.b3.text: … And I will abolish bow and sword and weapons of war in the land, and will make them lie down in safety.

hosea.2.p3.b4.text: So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.

hosea.2.p3.b5.text: I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ …

hosea.2.p3.b6.text: They will say, ‘You are my God.’
